notes.title: Update #7
notes.content:
Smaller update this time, but still with some good stuff for ya!

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Drastically overhauled the look of the starting map! It’s so nice, a family of birds have even moved in!
[*] Added a sign to the leaderboard bubble showing the name of the current level
[*] Decreased the volume of music in bonus rooms to better match the volume of the levels' music
[*] Optimized the lighting in the overworlds
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33419557/f6fa52c192df5fb3ac2ae9cf46721961e7029ab8.png[/img]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed debug outputs
[*] Moved the loading splash screen to an easily visible location
[*] Fixed a bug that would confuse the game about whether or not your body was touching a platform(This one was a doozy!)
[*] Fixed an issue with the location returning from the bonus room in Harrowing HeightsFixed the bonus room warp object in Treacherous Trek warping you to the starting map instead of the proper bonus room
[*] Stopped the giant saws in Treacherous Trek from clipping into walls
[*] Fixed two spots in Lava Labyrinth where rails and poles didn’t line up right 
[*] Fixed the Comfort Grid orb in the starting map having collision on while invisible
[*] Fixed an issue with our packaging process that was causing some game map data to be missing
[/list]

We’ve also temporarily removed the ability to switch the language from English. (Apologies, international fans!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33419557/6c219ab598aef770ad6aaa5c3e464ae647036427.png[/img]

notes.title: Anniversary Update!
notes.content:
[i]Happy (Belated) Anniversary![/i] To celebrate a year of not looking down, we’re making some big changes to the game, and…. most importantly… [i][b]slashing the price![/b][/i] Whether you’ve been with us since the beginning or you’re just coming on now, we’re happy to have you ːsteamhappyː

Here’s to another year of blastin' through levels, smashin' bots, and givin' Gearheart what for! *clink*

[u][b]Improvements[/b][/u]

Level signs better convey your completion info:
-show end-of-level flag on the big star to signify you’ve beaten the level
-show bonus room coin on the small start to signify you’ve beaten the bonus room
-show the best speedrun medal you’ve achieved for that level

Arrow signs now bob back-and-forth in the direction they point. They’re so excited to show you around!

Chains on flying drone holds are twice as thick

“Skip tutorial” orb in starting map is easier to reach

Added a particle effect that plays when you grab a pickup

Made signs, path markers, and some handholds more efficient to render

[u][b]Fixes:[/b][/u]

[b]Now with 50% less ear bleeding![/b] – Adjusted volume and attenuation settings on [i]many[/i] different sounds to make them quieter

Fixed a bug in ghost race recording that would only keep your ghost data from after you returned to the level from a bonus room

Pickups spawned by pickup spawners are now properly concealed by the poof cloud

Spinning glow effect in starting map no longer casts shadows

[u][b]Level Tweaks:[/b][/u]

Earthy Entry - removed gaps in starting mesh grid and added arrow signs pointing to flag
Climber’s Calamity - reduced Bonus Room timer duration
Firey Falls - fixed a bee clipping into a wall
Daunting Dangle - increased Bonus Room timer duration, made first bot after Checky slower, made first armor after Checky easier to reach, and increased height of all poles
Daredevil Dash - slightly moved second breakable wall and slowed the bot in front of it
Perilous Production - swapped spawned Armored Bots for easier bots
Harrowing Heights - changed the spawn location when returning from the Bonus Room
Treacherous Trek - put holds around the breakable wall with the jetpack
Gearheart’s Gambit - added some safe holds to the torso and arm gauntlets

Dodgey Dilemma, Transfer Trails, Risky Rails, and Firey Falls - added flat surfaces for the moving holds to path along

Multiple levels - fixed pickups inside breakable walls clipping into the cavity and/or slightly adjusted breakable wall location

 

…Also, we upgraded from Unreal 4.16 to 4.24! This should help the game run better across the board, among other things. We always do our best to test, but this kind of thing can introduce new bugs. If you find one, please let us know in our Discord channel!

https://discord.gg/bWVz5Jp

notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
What's good, Climbers? It's been a while, but we're working to return to a more stable update schedule.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33419557/83d3eb5294cfe41146bb4323f52b86050d354b0c.png[/img]

We've got some real good stuff cooking, including some high-caliber fixes! Here's what you'll be able to savor in this update...

Changes:
[list]
[*] Enemies blow up when they touch the fog planes in levels
[*] Hands no longer buzz or show the grab outline when you're prevented from grabbing things (such as when you're dead)
[*] Crumbling holds flicker as they respawn out of the wall
[*] Adjusted the layout of the difficulty mods bubble
[*] Adjusted some walls in Doombot Crusade to make learning about the fall projection system easier
[*] Made some pickup challenges in Treacherous Trek and Perilous Productions easier
[*] Ghost racing defaults to Local instead of Off (still defaults to Off in Arcade version)
[*] Halved force required to smash energy cores in the final boss fight
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Level times should properly submit to the global leaderboard (sorry about that one!)
[*] Regardless of the Ghost Racing setting, your ghost becomes the new global ghost if you beat the global best time for a level 
[*] Setting Ghost Racing to Off now actually works!
[*] Bonus room coins can no longer be grabbed after the timer runs out
[*] Plaque spins to the proper location on the leaderboard when you confirm your initials
[*] Adjusted walls in Zappy Zoom so a bee no longer clips into them
[*] Fixed a bug with Gearheart's audio in the final boss fight
[*] Fixed a bug where you could grab the Confirm orb in the leaderboard bubble multiple times in a row for a wonky result
[/list]

Additionally, we are aware of an issue preventing global ghost racing, and we [i]are[/i] working on it!  ːsteamhappyː


See you all at the next update!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33419557/31a5da87a72d92dfd07a36b2d2232616ac025ac1.png[/img]

notes.title: Week 3 Update
notes.content:
Hello again, fans of [i]Don't Look Down[/i]!

(I need a name for that...
Climbers?
DLD-ers?
Bot-Busters?
Downers?
... We'll come up with something eventually.)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33419557/feac9d5cf000107465a1ba69d21c113279f4d5ab.png[/img]

Anyway, this week brings a smaller update. Here are the changes:

-Fixed a bug that prevented achievements from being granted. [b]If you had already completed the requirements for an achievement, do any event counting towards the achievement to get it.[/b] (For example, if you'd already grabbed >50 powerups, grab one more to get the achievement; if you've beaten every Zone 1 level, beat any Zone 1 level again to get the achievement; etc.)

-Tweaked the language on an orb in the leaderboard bubble to better explain its purpose (grab it to toggle between looking at the local and global leaderboards)

-Made various performance optimizations (which I'd be happy to list, but I don't think most of you will care!)


See you at the next update!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33419557/cd16fe39f9a1512160ac481772c5d534fdfefbb3.png[/img]

notes.title: Week 2 Update
notes.content:
Hello, [i]Don't Look Down[/i] fans!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33419557/d1ad76bd097abf8a8a2b7377c8e0240e7a45dfde.png[/img]

We've got a nice assortment of improvements, tweaks, and bug fixes ready. Here's what we've got for ya:

-Tweaked off-center detection system to be a bit less intrusive and a bit better at differentiating leaning vs. stepping off-center
-Improved user experience with the singing orb keyboard
-You're now invincible right after grabbing a bonus room warp object
-Improved signage in Doombot Crusade and Ropey Romp
-Various audio updates: improved the mix by making several sounds quieter, adjusted some attenuation settings, made the laser sound loop properly, and fixed a couple instances where sounds would layer over each other and get too loud

-Graphics settings are now properly saved and applied when the game starts up
-Checky can no longer be activated when you're dead
-Fixed a bug where recentering didn't behave right if you started the level on a platform and hadn't climbed yet
-Fixed a bug that made the global leaderboard display the entries twice


Stay tuned for all the sweet ways we're gonna keep improving DLD going forward :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33419557/131fed8ea3f52d981a679139db3347a4694b19b8.png[/img]

notes.title: Week 1 Update!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who purchased [i]Don't Look Down[/i] during launch week! :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33419557/e46ea7ee3dacbc226d1ec310f4b8ab60ff4d4a3e.png[/img]

We've fixed some bugs and made some changes to the game based on your feedback.
Here are the changes:

-You can see the global leaderboard if you have difficulty mods enabled (but your times still aren't submitted to the leaderboard)
-The leaderboard remembers the last name you entered so you don't have to enter it every time (but how cute are those orbs, man?)
-Times for speedrun medals are shown on the medal plaque
-The lava at the start of EvilEruption waits to rise until you grab a hold
-Fixed visual bugs on a secret customization you're totally never gonna find ;)
-Tweaked the racing ghosts so they're less likely to overlap
-Text of large signs no longer floats off the sign
-Grab outlines work in the Bot Guide
-Fixed a bug where the flame launcher could stay on your wrist if you got hit while acquiring it
-Fixed the location of the player start in Colossal Creations (oopsie)
-Moved two bots in the final level, Gearheart's Gambit, to where they belong

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33419557/5cb016453b1cb6e69cc9ddf75ebd0d2209df7cb3.png[/img]
